title: Object Storage: invoice due days
content:
Object Storage invoice due days is defined as follows: Calendar days after invoice issue for payment maturity; integer.

| Contract tier | Invoice due days |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | invoice due days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | invoice due days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | invoice due days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | invoice due days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | invoice due days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | invoice due days: 30 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the invoice due days entry is 30.
